Skills-docs: none (no published surface moves; nothing under `skills/` names the scripts)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:删除四个一次性拆分脚本(`scripts/codemod-split-{engine,protocol,sql-driver,conversions-registry}.mjs`,共 15,933 行);199 个文件里点名它们的注释改为点名完成该次拆分的 PR(「split by #NNNNN」),只改注释行、原地改写,每个文件行数不变;另把 `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs` 一处同样点名已删脚本的说明字符串改为「split by #29993」(席位已批准扩面,纯文字)。
- 为什么改:维护者裁定清理;这四个脚本各自只跑过一次,现在没有任何代码、门禁、workflow 或 package script 运行、导入或读取它们。
- 风险与回滚:零行为改动(diff 中修改的行除一处说明字符串外全部是注释行,已机械核对;该字符串没有任何测试或门禁读取其原文);发布产物里不含被改注释(构建后 `dist/` 中 `split by #` 与 `codemod-split-` 均 0 命中)。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs` 第 437 行(原先仍点名已删脚本的唯一一处字符串字面量,本轮已改写);`scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`、`scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`(被改注释的门禁横幅)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n codemod-split-`,预期零输出(退出码 1)。
- 需要你做的:本 PR 超过 3,000 行,按 Tier H 由你批准合并;席位 L1 后交棒。

## What changes

- Deletes `scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` (7,452 lines), `scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs` (4,164), `scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs` (2,950) and `scripts/codemod-split-conversions-registry.mjs` (1,367).
- Rewords every comment that named one of them (201 comment edits in 199 files: facet-module headers, the 112 conversion-entry headers, gate banners) so it cites the PR that made that split. Each edit is in place: every modified file keeps its line count, and every changed line is a comment line.
- Per-script PR mapping, read from `git log` of each script and `git blame` of each comment line:
  - engine: added by #30012; comments now cite #30012, #30083, #30264, #30341, #30415, #30463, #30571, #30716, #30987, #31116, #31151, #31665, #31764, #31922, #32046.
  - protocol: added by #29998; comments cite #29998, #30687, #30954, #32068, #32463.
  - sql-driver: added by #29598; comments cite #29598, #30139, #30249, #30306, #30363, #30441.
  - conversions-registry: added by #29993; comments cite #29993.
- Rewords the one string literal that still named a deleted script: the `why` of the `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` entry in `NOT_DRIVER_MANAGED` (`scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs:437`) now reads "(split by #29993)". Text only; widened by the seat answer on this PR (comment 6912161808).
- Size: 204 paths (4 deleted, 200 modified: 199 reworded comment files plus `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs`), +342 / -16,275.

## Tests

No test or test expectation changes. Premise (nothing runs, imports or reads the scripts), measured with `git grep` on this branch at its base `35c9a305f06`:

- `codemod-split` in every `package.json`: 0 files; in `.github/**`: 0; in `turbo.json`: 0; in vitest configs, tsconfigs, `eslint.config.mjs`, `.husky/**`, `.claude/**`: 0; in `*.md`, `*.mdx`, `docs/**`, `content/**`, `skills/**`: 0.
- `codemod-split-`: 204 files (the four scripts plus 200 that name them); `codemod-split` without the trailing hyphen: 0.
- Spellings that reach a script by import, require, spawn, exec or fork: 0 (three hits are comments of the form "Written by ...").
- The 202 naming lines: 201 are comment lines; one is the string literal in `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs:437` (prose in a `NOT_DRIVER_MANAGED` entry's `why`; it does not run or read the script).
- The four scripts' `--self-test` modes are run by no workflow, so `check:self-test-wired` does not count them.

## Acceptance notes

- **`scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs:437`: closed in this PR.** The seat widened the surface to that one literal; it now cites #29993 (re-measured: `git log --diff-filter=A` of `packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/*` gives `d79eecfe5 … (#29987) (#29993)`). `git grep -n codemod-split-` on the branch is now empty (exit 1). No test or gate reads that `why` text: the sentence has no other hit in the tree.
- `.gitignore` keeps `packages/spec/.codemod-arrays-*/`, an ignore entry for the deleted conversions codemod's scratch dir. It is now dead, and removing it is not a comment edit, so it stays. Carrier: none, noted here.
- No changeset: the reworded comments do not reach any package's published files (after a build of the four touched packages, `split by #` and `codemod-split-` both have 0 hits in their `dist/`; positive control: other facet-header text such as "A MOVE, not a redesign" does appear in the objectql and metadata-protocol `dist/`). Labelled `skip-changeset`.
- `git merge-tree` against the four open PRs that touch the same files (#34347, #34324, #34285, #34238) gives a clean merge for each.
